category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: The first release is open from the start
history.description: A new ledger opens with version 1 already in progress, so the first survey of the codebase records straight onto it. That survey is an inventory of work that already existed, and cutting version 1 afterwards — dated when the work actually began — is what turns it into the first edition.
history.dev_notes: cmdInit seeds releases.json with a single { version: 1, status: "future" }.
